# 12-Week Strength Programme for Post-Meniscus Repair Client

## Client Profile & Constraints
- 36-year-old male, recreational lifter
- Right medial meniscus repair (6 months post-op, cleared for low-impact strength)
- **Restrictions:** No jumping, no deep knee flexion under load (avoid full squats, deep lunges, leg press)
- **Goal:** Strength development + ski-specific conditioning for return to skiing
- **Timeline:** 12 weeks

---

## Programme Overview

This programme is structured in three 4-week phases:

1. **Phase 1 (Weeks 1–4): Foundation & Movement Quality** — Establish pain-free movement patterns, build aerobic base, activate stabilisers
2. **Phase 2 (Weeks 5–8): Strength Development** — Progressive loading on compound movements, ski-specific power development
3. **Phase 3 (Weeks 9–12): Sport-Specific Integration** — High-intensity strength, eccentric control, dynamic stability

**Training frequency:** 4 days per week (2 lower-body focused, 2 upper-body focused, with integrated core/stability work)

---

## PHASE 1: Foundation & Movement Quality (Weeks 1–4)

### Goals
- Restore confidence in the right knee
- Build glute and hip stability
- Establish movement patterns that respect the meniscus repair
- Develop aerobic base and work capacity

### Weekly Structure
- **Day 1:** Lower-body A (Glute/Hip focus)
- **Day 2:** Upper-body A (Horizontal push/pull)
- **Day 3:** Lower-body B (Quad/Stability focus)
- **Day 4:** Upper-body B (Vertical push/pull + Core)

Rest days: 48 hours between lower-body sessions where possible.

---

### **Week 1**

#### **Day 1: Lower-Body A (Glute/Hip Focus)**

| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Notes |
|----------|------|------|-------|
| Bike or rowing warm-up | 1 | 5 min | Easy pace, get blood flowing |
| Glute bridges | 3 | 12 | Controlled, 2-sec hold at top |
| Single-leg glute bridge (R) | 3 | 8 | Right leg emphasis; use left for balance |
| Clamshells (banded) | 3 | 12 | Each side; focus on glute med activation |
| Lateral band walks | 3 | 12 | Each direction; light band |
| Deadlifts (conventional, light) | 3 | 8 | 50% estimated 1RM; focus on hip hinge |
| Pallof press (cable) | 3 | 10 | Each side; anti-rotation core work |
| Sled push (light) | 2 | 20m | Quad engagement without knee stress |

**Finisher:** 5 min easy bike

---

#### **Day 2: Upper-Body A (Horizontal Push/Pull)**

| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Notes |
|----------|------|------|-------|
| Rowing machine warm-up | 1 | 5 min | Moderate pace |
| Bench press (barbell or dumbbell) | 4 | 6–8 | RPE 6/10; controlled tempo |
| Bent-over barbell row | 4 | 6–8 | Match bench press intensity |
| Dumbbell floor press | 3 | 8 | Unilateral stability; lighter load |
| Seal rows (chest-supported) | 3 | 10 | Reduce lower-back strain |
| Face pulls (cable) | 3 | 12 | Shoulder health; light weight |
| Plank hold | 3 | 30 sec | Neutral spine |

**Finisher:** 3 min rowing

---

#### **Day 3: Lower-Body B (Quad/Stability Focus)**

| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Notes |
|----------|------|------|-------|
| Bike warm-up | 1 | 5 min | Easy |
| Step-ups (low box, 12 inches) | 3 | 8 | Each leg; bodyweight or light dumbbell |
| Leg extension (machine) | 3 | 12 | Controlled; 2-sec pause at top |
| Split stance RDL (R leg forward) | 3 | 8 | Right leg emphasis; light dumbbell |
| Copenhagen adductor squeeze | 3 | 12 | Medial stability; light resistance |
| Reverse sled drag | 2 | 20m | Quad focus without deep flexion |
| Dead bug | 3 | 10 | Each side; core stability |
| Glute-ham raise (assisted if needed) | 2 | 6 | Eccentric emphasis |

**Finisher:** 5 min easy bike

---

#### **Day 4: Upper-Body B (Vertical Push/Pull + Core)**

| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Notes |
|----------|------|------|-------|
| Rowing warm-up | 1 | 5 min | Moderate |
| Overhead press (barbell) | 4 | 6–8 | RPE 6/10; strict form |
| Pull-ups or lat pulldown | 4 | 6–8 | Match press intensity |
| Dumbbell shoulder press | 3 | 8 | Unilateral stability |
| Assisted pull-ups (if needed) | 3 | 8 | Build pulling strength |
| Landmine rotations | 3 | 10 | Each side; anti-rotation core |
| Ab wheel rollout (from knees) | 3 | 8 | Anterior core; controlled |
| Suitcase carry | 3 | 30m | Each side; lateral stability |

**Finisher:** 3 min rowing

---

### **Week 2**

Repeat Week 1 structure, with minor progression:
- Add 1 rep to each main lift (bench, row, press, pull-ups)
- Increase band resistance on lateral walks and clamshells
- Extend sled work to 25m
- Increase plank hold to 40 sec

---

### **Week 3**

- Main lifts: Add 5 lbs to upper-body pressing/pulling
- Lower-body: Increase step-up box height to 14 inches
- Leg extension: Add 5 lbs
- Increase sled work to 30m
- Extend plank to 45 sec
- Add 1 rep to all accessory work

---

### **Week 4**

- Upper-body main lifts: Add another 5 lbs
- Lower-body: Increase step-up height to 16 inches
- Deadlifts: Progress to 60% estimated 1RM
- Sled work: 35m
- Plank: 50 sec
- Add 1 rep to all accessory work

**End of Phase 1 assessment:** Client should feel confident in the knee, demonstrate good glute activation, and have established a solid aerobic base.

---

## PHASE 2: Strength Development (Weeks 5–8)

### Goals
- Build absolute strength in lower-body patterns that respect the meniscus
- Develop ski-specific power (lateral stability, eccentric control)
- Increase training density and intensity
- Introduce unilateral lower-body strength work

### Key Changes
- Increase frequency of main lifts
- Introduce tempo work and eccentric emphasis
- Add ski-specific movements (lateral bounds, lateral step-downs)
- Progress to moderate-heavy loading

### Weekly Structure
- **Day 1:** Lower-body A (Deadlift focus + Unilateral)
- **Day 2:** Upper-body A (Bench + Row)
- **Day 3:** Lower-body B (Quad + Lateral stability)
- **Day 4:** Upper-body B (Press + Pull + Core)

---

### **Week 5**

#### **Day 1: Lower-Body A (Deadlift + Unilateral)**

| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Notes |
|----------|------|------|-------|
| Bike warm-up | 1 | 5 min | Moderate |
| Deadlifts (conventional) | 5 | 5 | 70% estimated 1RM; 2-sec eccentric |
| Single-leg RDL (R leg) | 4 | 6 | Right leg emphasis; dumbbell |
| Bulgarian split squat (R leg back) | 3 | 6 | Shallow depth; rear foot elevated |
| Lateral step-down (R leg) | 3 | 8 | Eccentric emphasis; 3-sec lower |
| Sled push (moderate weight) | 3 | 25m | Quad and glute drive |
| Pallof press (heavier) | 3 | 8 | Each side |
| Suitcase carry | 3 | 40m | Each side |

**Finisher:** 5 min bike

---

#### **Day 2: Upper-Body A (Bench + Row)**

| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Notes |
|----------|------|------|-------|
| Rowing warm-up | 1 | 5 min | Moderate |
| Bench press (barbell) | 5 | 5 | 75% estimated 1RM; 2-sec eccentric |
| Bent-over barbell row | 5 | 5 | Match bench intensity |
| Incline dumbbell press | 3 | 6 | Unilateral stability |
| Seal rows | 3 | 8 | Chest-supported |
| Dumbbell floor press | 3 | 8 | Unilateral; lighter |
| Face pulls | 3 | 12 | Shoulder health |
| Plank hold | 3 | 60 sec | Neutral spine |

**Finisher:** 3 min rowing

---

#### **Day 3: Lower-Body B (Quad + Lateral Stability)**

| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Notes |
|----------|------|------|-------|
| Bike warm-up | 1 | 5 min | Easy |
| Step-ups (16-inch box) | 4 | 6 | Each leg; dumbbell or barbell |
| Leg extension (machine) | 4 | 8 | Moderate weight; 2-sec pause |
| Lateral band walks (heavy band) | 3 | 12 | Each direction; ski-specific |
| Lateral lunge (light) | 3 | 6 | Each side; controlled |
| Reverse sled drag | 3 | 25m | Quad focus |
| Copenhagen squeeze | 3 | 15 | Medial stability |
| Dead bug | 3 | 12 | Each side |

**Finisher:** 5 min bike

---

#### **Day 4: Upper-Body B (Press + Pull + Core)**

| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Notes |
|----------|------|------|-------|
| Rowing warm-up | 1 | 5 min | Moderate |
| Overhead press (barbell) | 5 | 5 | 75% estimated 1RM |
| Pull-ups or lat pulldown | 5 | 5 | Match press intensity |
| Dumbbell shoulder press | 3 | 6 | Unilateral |
| Assisted pull-ups | 3 | 8 | Build pulling strength |
| Landmine rotations | 3 | 10 | Each side; heavier |
| Ab wheel rollout | 3 | 10 | From knees; controlled |
| Suitcase carry | 3 | 45m | Each side |

**Finisher:** 3 min rowing

---

### **Week 6**

- Deadlifts: 5 × 5 @ 72% 1RM
- Bench press: 5 × 5 @ 77% 1RM
- Overhead press: 5 × 5 @ 77% 1RM
- Bent-over row: 5 × 5 @ 77% 1RM
- Pull-ups: Add 1 rep or increase resistance
- Single-leg RDL: 4 × 7
- Step-ups: 4 × 7
- Leg extension: 4 × 10
- Lateral band walks: 3 × 15
- Increase sled work to 30m
- Plank: 70 sec

---

### **Week 7**

- Deadlifts: 5 × 5 @ 75% 1RM
- Bench press: 5 × 5 @ 80% 1RM
- Overhead press: 5 × 5 @ 80% 1RM
- Bent-over row: 5 × 5 @ 80% 1RM
- Pull-ups: Add 1 rep or increase resistance
- Single-leg RDL: 4 × 8
- Step-ups: 4 × 8
- Leg extension: 4 × 12
- Lateral band walks: 3 × 15 (heavier band)
- Lateral lunge: 3 × 8
- Sled work: 35m
- Plank: 80 sec

---

### **Week 8**

- Deadlifts: 5 × 5 @ 77% 1RM
- Bench press: 5 × 5 @ 82% 1RM
- Overhead press: 5 × 5 @ 82% 1RM
- Bent-over row: 5 × 5 @ 82% 1RM
- Pull-ups: Add 1 rep or increase resistance
- Single-leg RDL: 4 × 8 (heavier)
- Step-ups: 4 × 8 (heavier)
- Leg extension: 4 × 12 (heavier)
- Lateral band walks: 3 × 15 (heavy band)
- Lateral lunge: 3 × 8 (light dumbbell)
- Sled work: 40m
- Plank: 90 sec

**End of Phase 2 assessment:** Client should demonstrate significant strength gains, good unilateral control, and confidence in lateral movements.

---

## PHASE 3: Sport-Specific Integration (Weeks 9–12)

### Goals
- Build eccentric strength and deceleration control (critical for skiing)
- Develop dynamic stability and reactive strength
- Introduce higher-intensity intervals
- Prepare for return to skiing with sport-specific demands

### Key Changes
- Increase eccentric emphasis and tempo work
- Add reactive/dynamic stability drills
- Introduce higher-intensity conditioning
- Reduce volume slightly, increase intensity
- Add sport-specific movements (lateral bounds, lateral step-downs with load)

### Weekly Structure
- **Day 1:** Lower-body A (Deadlift + Eccentric/Reactive)
- **Day 2:** Upper-body A (Bench + Row + Conditioning)
- **Day 3:** Lower-body B (Quad + Dynamic Stability)
- **Day 4:** Upper-body B (Press + Pull + Core + Conditioning)

---

### **Week 9**

#### **Day 1: Lower-Body A (Deadlift + Eccentric/Reactive)**

| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Notes |
|----------|------|------|-------|
| Bike warm-up | 1 | 5 min | Moderate |
| Deadlifts (conventional) | 5 | 3 | 80% estimated 1RM; 3-sec eccentric |
| Single-leg RDL (R leg) | 4 | 6 | Heavy dumbbell; eccentric emphasis |
| Lateral step-down (R leg) | 4 | 6 | 3-sec eccentric; 16-inch box |
| Bulgarian split squat (R leg back) | 3 | 6 | Heavier; controlled |
| Sled push (heavy) | 3 | 20m | Explosive drive |
| Pallof press (heavy) | 3 | 8 | Each side; explosive |
| Suitcase carry (heavy) | 3 | 50m | Each side |

**Finisher:** 5 min bike (moderate intensity)

---

#### **Day 2: Upper-Body A (Bench + Row + Conditioning)**

| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Notes |
|----------|------|------|-------|
| Rowing warm-up | 1 | 5 min | Moderate |
| Bench press (barbell) | 5 | 3 | 82% estimated 1RM; 2-sec eccentric |
| Bent-over barbell row | 5 | 3 | Match bench intensity |
| Incline dumbbell press | 3 | 6 | Unilateral; heavier |
| Seal rows | 3 | 8 | Chest-supported |
| Dumbbell floor press | 3 | 8 | Unilateral |
| Face pulls | 3 | 15 | Shoulder health; moderate weight |

**Conditioning finisher:** 3 rounds of:
- 10 rowing machine sprints (20 sec hard, 40 sec easy)
- 30 sec rest between rounds

---

#### **Day 3: Lower-Body B (Quad + Dynamic Stability)**

| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Notes |
|----------|------|------|-------|
| Bike warm-up | 1 | 5 min | Easy |
| Step-ups (16-inch box) | 4 | 6 | Heavy dumbbell or barbell; explosive |
| Leg extension (machine) | 4 | 8 | Heavy; 2-sec pause |
| Lateral band walks (heavy band) | 3 | 12 | Each direction; explosive |
| Lateral lunge (dumbbell) | 3 | 6 | Each side; heavier |
| Reverse sled drag (heavy) | 3 | 20m | Quad focus; explosive |
| Copenhagen squeeze | 3 | 15 | Medial stability |
| Lateral step-down (L leg) | 3 | 6 | 3-sec eccentric; balance work |

**Finisher:** 5 min bike (moderate intensity)

---

#### **Day 4: Upper-Body B (Press + Pull + Core + Conditioning)**

| Exercise | Sets | Reps | Notes |
|----------|------|------|-------|
| Rowing warm-up | 1 | 5 min | Moderate |
| Overhead press (barbell) | 5 | 3 | 82% estimated 1RM |
| Pull-ups or lat pulldown | 5 | 3 | Match press intensity; add weight if needed |
| Dumbbell shoulder press | 3 | 6 | Unilateral; heavier |
| Assisted pull-ups | 3 | 8 | Build pulling strength |
| Landmine rotations | 3 | 10 | Each side; heavy |
| Ab wheel rollout | 3 | 12 | From knees; explosive |
| Suitcase carry (heavy) | 3 | 50m | Each side |

**Conditioning finisher:** 3 rounds of:
- 8 pull-ups (or lat pulldowns)
- 12 landmine rotations (each side)
- 30 sec rest between rounds

---

### **Week 10**

- Deadlifts: 5 × 3 @ 82% 1RM (3-sec eccentric)
- Bench press: 5 × 3 @ 84% 1RM
- Overhead press: 5 × 3 @ 84% 1RM
- Bent-over row: 5 × 3 @ 84% 1RM
- Pull-ups: 5 × 3 (add weight if needed)
- Single-leg RDL: 4 × 7 (heavier)
- Step-ups: 4 × 7 (heavier)
- Leg extension: 4 × 10 (heavier)
- Lateral band walks: 3 × 15 (heaviest band)
- Lateral lunge: 3 × 7 (heavier)
- Lateral step-down: 4 × 6 (3-sec eccentric)
- Sled work: 25m (heavy)
- Conditioning: Increase to 4 rounds of rowing sprints

---

### **Week 11**

- Deadlifts: 5 × 3 @ 84% 1RM (3-sec eccentric)
- Bench press: 5 × 3 @ 85% 1RM
- Overhead press: 5 × 3 @ 85% 1RM
- Bent-over row: 5 × 3 @ 85% 1RM
- Pull-ups: 5 × 3 (add weight if needed)
- Single-leg RDL: 4 × 8 (heavy)
- Step-ups: 4 × 8 (heavy)
- Leg extension: 4 × 10 (heavy)
- Lateral band walks: 3 × 15 (heaviest band)
- Lateral lunge: 3 × 8 (dumbbell)
- Lateral step-down: 4 × 7 (3-sec eccentric)
- Sled work: 30m (heavy)
- Conditioning: 4 rounds of rowing sprints + pull-up/landmine circuit

---

### **Week 12 (Deload/Assessment)**

Reduce volume by 40%, maintain intensity:

- Deadlifts: 3 × 3 @ 80% 1RM
- Bench press: 3 × 3 @ 82% 1RM
- Overhead press: 3 × 3 @ 82% 1RM
- Bent-over row: 3 × 3 @ 82% 1RM
- Pull-ups: 3 × 3 (moderate weight)
- Single-leg RDL: 3 × 6 (moderate weight)
- Step-ups: 3 × 6 (moderate weight)
- Leg extension: 3 × 8 (moderate weight)
- Lateral band walks: 2 × 12 (moderate band)
- Lateral lunge: 2 × 6 (light dumbbell)
- Lateral step-down: 2 × 6 (light eccentric)
- Sled work: 20m (moderate weight)
- Conditioning: 2 rounds of rowing sprints

**End of Week 12:** Perform strength testing (estimated 1RM on deadlift, bench, press) and functional assessment (single-leg balance, lateral stability, step-down control).

---

## Nutrition & Recovery Recommendations

### Nutrition
- **Protein:** 0.8–1.0 g per lb bodyweight daily (support muscle recovery and adaptation)
- **Carbohydrates:** 3–5 g per lb bodyweight daily (fuel training and recovery)
- **Fats:** 0.3–0.4 g per lb bodyweight daily (hormone support)
- **Hydration:** 3–4 liters water daily; more on training days
- **Meal timing:** Eat a balanced meal (protein + carbs + fat) 2–3 hours before training; consume protein + carbs within 1–2 hours post-training

### Recovery
- **Sleep:** 7–9 hours per night (critical for adaptation and knee healing)
- **Mobility work:** 10–15 min daily, focusing on hip flexors, hamstrings, calves, and ankle mobility
- **Foam rolling:** 5–10 min post-training on lower body (avoid direct pressure on the knee)
- **Ice/heat:** Ice the knee for 10–15 min post-training if any swelling; heat before training to increase mobility
- **Active recovery days:** Light walking, swimming, or cycling on rest days (20–30 min, easy pace)
- **Monitoring:** Track knee pain/swelling daily; if pain increases, reduce volume by 20%
